name: Plaza Donuts
notes: All 4 photos were menu boards. 1.jpg and 2.jpg show the same ice-blended-drink board plus a croissant/bagel sandwich sign (with pink price stickers); 4.jpg shows the printed donut/sandwich/coffee board; 3.jpg is a close-up of a handwritten whiteboard sandwich menu with lower prices than the printed board. Used the printed-board sandwich prices since they match the pink price stickers physically on the wall in 1.jpg; the whiteboard version (#1 $4.50 / #2 $5.50 / #3 $6.50 / #4 $7.00 / #5 $8.50) appears outdated or a separate location's sign. Ice-blended drink flavors, iced-coffee flavors, and cappuccino flavors are listed without an unambiguous per-item price (only size-tiered totals), so price is omitted and sizes are given in description instead.
